title: Same $20: What Do ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini Give You? Models, Limits, Context (2026)
description:
For about $20 a month, do ChatGPT Plus, Claude Pro and Google AI Pro buy the same thing? This video lays out the models, usage and how much each can read at once, side by side.
It is for people deciding whether to pay who don't know how the three differ.

It covers the prices of the three plans, where each flagship model sits, how usage and context differ, unique features such as Claude Code, Codex and video generation, Taiwan prices and annual plans, and a worked check of whether a 200-page report fits. Prices and features come from the official pages in September 2026; what you see after logging in takes precedence.

chapters.models: Does the top model come along?

9284.text: My view: at $20, this is the row most likely to differ a lot.

5dzg.text: $20 a month: do all three AIs sell the same thing?

5j8r.text: You assume a similar price buys a similar product.

gb7z.text: But the three spend your money in very different places.

tgz3.text: Just on how much it reads at once, Gemini's plans are over 30 times apart.

kmuz.text: Models, usage, how much it reads at once: this video compares each.

prts.text: First, which plans sit at the $20 tier?

qncs.text: Claude's plan is Pro, also $20 monthly.

pcxk.text: Google AI Pro costs $19.99 in the US.

v7zx.text: The short answer: each one buys something different.

k9zn.text: Or more content read at once.

365y.text: But if you pay, does the strongest model come along?

cc4e.text: On models, the three work differently.

aphm.text: At ChatGPT, Sol only comes with Plus and up.

dq45.text: Free and Go don't have it.

jef9.text: Claude Pro adds Opus; free doesn't.

cji8.text: On Pro, Claude's Fable needs extra usage credits.

rtkb.text: Gemini differs: even the free tier reaches a Pro model.

xfmx.text: Gemini's free tier, in its own words.

i85v.text: The AI Pro description says it unlocks more access to use the most capable Pro model.

esww.text: What about usage, and how much it reads at once?

35hy.text: Usage first, the wall people hit most.

qq5y.text: Claude Pro usage resets every five hours, plus a weekly cap.

zrce.text: Gemini AI Pro gets four times the free usage, also resetting every five hours.

wm8p.text: ChatGPT Plus chat: the site only says more messages and uploads, no numbers.

rxvp.text: From plan names alone, you can't tell if you'll hit the wall.

h7wt.text: For coding, Codex does have estimated numbers.

wkj5.text: Plus with Sol: roughly 15 to 160 local messages every five hours.

zy7w.text: That's an estimate, not a fixed cap; weekly limits may apply too.

cii3.text: Now how much it reads at once, called context.

uxq3.text: Claude goes up to 1 million, depending on model.

wg56.text: Gemini follows the plan entirely: free is 32K.

9xau.text: AI Pro jumps to 1 million, over 30 times more.

rbvq.text: Google says 1 million tokens is about 1,500 pages.

8bv4.text: At that ratio, free fits about 48 pages, AI Plus about 192.

kymt.text: ChatGPT's site does the page math.

bsqu.text: Claude gives no pages: up to 1 million, by model.

mzfa.text: If it doesn't fit, Google warns answers may miss details.

itwf.text: The table and decision chart are in the article, first line below.

mgme.text: Beyond models and limits, what unique features does each have?

9fim.text: Each has something the others lack at this tier.

afft.text: It works on the web, command line, editor and iOS.

pr79.text: Claude Pro has Claude Code; the free plan doesn't.

gt6g.text: Google AI Pro adds video generation.

kvju.text: Flow is Google's AI creative studio, used for making video scenes.

mx6c.text: Now ChatGPT Plus: the extras in the table.

suek.text: Deep research: limited on the free plan and Go.

figp.text: Image generation with Thinking: from Plus.

wx7y.text: Interactive tables and charts: Plus and up.

way4.text: Plus can pick legacy models; free and Go can't.

dczq.text: Claude Pro's table also lists quite a few extras.

aw45.text: Claude Code, for coding; the free plan doesn't have it.

8pmc.text: The design, slides and documents tools are Pro only.

e93x.text: Microsoft 365 integration is Pro only too.

iqsc.text: Coders: first see which tool suits you.

x6zs.text: For video, Gemini can generate video from AI Plus up.

4cca.text: My view: if you won't use a feature, no need to pay for it.

wwne.text: So in Taiwan, what do these plans actually cost?

d82r.text: ChatGPT lists $20; the NT$ price depends on your checkout page.

u75p.text: Claude also lists $20, and the price excludes tax.

9u7y.text: Google's Taiwan page lists NT$ directly: AI Pro is NT$650 a month.

zbvk.text: On annual plans, the three differ.

499y.text: Claude Pro annual is $200 once; monthly totals $240 a year.

xr7c.text: So a full year saves $40, about $3.33 a month.

rn7x.text: ChatGPT Plus's site only lists a monthly plan.

hjfa.text: Gemini's Taiwan page also lists only monthly.

ys33.text: So at this tier, which one should you buy?

srde.text: Back to the opening question: same $20, different purchases.

xbdx.text: ChatGPT Plus buys you the Sol model, along with Codex.

3nqx.text: Claude Pro buys the Opus model and Claude Code.

dv2r.text: Google AI Pro buys four times the usage, 1 million context and creative credits.

657t.text: My view: at $20, this isn't everyone's first step.

xrdw.text: For occasional questions, free is enough.

txpz.text: Only heavy daily writing, long documents, coding or video justify paying.

5vgs.text: Usually an entry plan is enough to start.

jbnx.text: As for Google AI Plus, the Taiwan page says NT$165 a month.

vmh8.text: If $20 still hits a wall, there's a tier above.

sg7x.text: ChatGPT Pro starts at $100, with three usage levels to choose.

czrs.text: Claude Max starts at $100: five or twenty times Pro's usage.

4jev.text: Google AI Ultra starts at $99.99 in the US.

8sup.text: Say someone often drops in long reports and free never finishes reading.

9hy2.text: Their limit is input size, not whose model is strongest.

k5ft.text: So they compare the context row first, then usage.

g9fb.text: To use up the free plan, first know where to check usage.

qjrm.text: Claude's settings have a usage page showing the next reset time.

8ns4.text: Gemini: bottom left, in settings, under usage limits.

n257.text: ChatGPT's Codex: check the usage dashboard.

kp5n.text: Before paying, I suggest doing three things.

hfgg.text: First, use free fully for two weeks; see where you're stuck.

8n35.text: Second, buy a month; consider annual once you know you'll stay.

hepu.text: Third, check both the in-app and web prices.

h7wv.text: My view: the first matters most; it shows you your own wall.

pqt2.text: So first work out which wall you hit, then pick the one for it.

kkm9.text: Prices change, so trust what you see after logging in. See you in the next video.
